findings.title: Preserve the established continuation-token response field
findings.explanation: This changes the serialized public field from `next_cursor` to `cursor` without any accompanying consumer, schema, or compatibility update. A page with `next_cursor="abc"` now omits `next_cursor`, so existing callers cannot obtain the continuation token and pagination fails. The same root cause covers both the response-contract and pagination-boundary concerns.
findings.failurePath: A caller serializes a nonterminal `Page`; `serialize_page` emits only `cursor`; a consumer reading the previously published `next_cursor` field receives no token and cannot request the next page.
